utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — that should be enough for now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll grab both and head over soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. That’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, it’s still on for today. I can help—just tell me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — could you bring the labels and any extra tape? We’re set for Sunday at the community center, and that’ll help keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring the labels and extra tape for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll head over soon and sort the donated tools by the garage. If I spot any extra screwdrivers, I’ll set one aside for Tess.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — that helps a lot. I’ll keep coordinating the pickup coverage and check for any schedule conflicts on my end.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll focus on the tools by the garage and flag any extras for Tess.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring the toolbox again and check what’s still missing. If you tell me the biggest fixes, I’ll make sure we’ve got the right tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — the biggest fixes are still the loose shelf and the wobbly chair, so if you can check for any missing tape, screwdrivers, or gloves too, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring tape, screwdrivers, and gloves, then we’ll tackle that shelf and chair first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that should cover the basics. Once Vik sends the time tomorrow, I’ll keep the task list tidy for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — once Vik confirms tomorrow, I’ll stay on the tool sorting and keep track of what still needs fixing for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Mara. Once Vik confirms tomorrow, I’ll keep the list in order and we’ll be set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on today, and it’s been picking up nicely all morning. If you’re heading over, I’d go soon so you don’t miss the good tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — I’m heading over now, and I’ll check the tool table first so I don’t miss anything important.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good call — I’ll be there soon too, and I’ll keep an eye out for any extra screwdrivers or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Opal — I’ve got you down and I’ll keep you posted if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll stay on the east end and check the bulletin board for any changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll spread any updates right away, and I appreciate you keeping an eye on the east end.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m a bit behind, but I’ll check the latest repair-drive update and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — please do, and send me the latest timing and supply list once you’ve checked it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll check the latest timing and supply list and send it your way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good — let’s start with the biggest fixes, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Could you check what’s still missing and tackle the biggest fix first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep repeating the Saturday repair drive plan and send the time tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — that’d be great. I’ll be there late, but I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll repeat the Saturday repair drive plan to everyone and send the time tomorrow. Thanks for helping out, even if you’re coming late.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m checking now — I’ll see what’s most urgent and who’s free, then I’ll report back so we can keep the drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect, Ira — once you know the urgent repairs and who’s free, send it over and I’ll help fill in any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll head around the block and check on the urgent repairs, then I’ll let you know who I can round up to help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mina — tape and gloves are perfect. If you hear any updates on timing or what else is needed, could you pass them along?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mina — I really appreciate it. I’m still a bit behind on the details, so I’ll wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—send me the list, and I’ll help sort out what’s still missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm the repair drive is still on for today?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, it’s still on for today—send over the list and I’ll help sort out what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense — let’s list the bigger items first, then figure out the easiest way to move and label them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good — I’m just worried we’ll run out of space, so let’s keep the heavy stuff near the door and note where each item goes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good call — I’ll help keep a clear list by the door so we can track each heavy item and where it needs to go.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m still available to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Can you help sort the donated tools first? If you spot an extra screwdriver, set one aside for Tess.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools first and set aside any extra screwdriver for Tess.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still a bit behind on the latest—what’s the update on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape, screwdrivers, and gloves on the list so far, and I’m still checking if we need anything else. If you hear of more supplies, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along any latest updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren — we’re coordinating the repair drive at the community center this afternoon. Want me to put your name down?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — yes please, put me down. I can bring my screwdriver set and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down, Oren. Your screwdriver set and flashlight will be super helpful!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still keeping tabs on the east end and the bulletin board, and I’ll flag any location changes right away. Tell me where you want me to check first for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let’s start with the east end and the bulletin board—if either changes, let me know right away. I’m still trying to keep it lined up with the school pickup window.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll check the east end and bulletin board first and report any changes right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah — I’m a bit late, but I can still help with the repair drive. Want me to check what tools we’re missing or spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Dane — could you check what tools we’re still missing? I’m a bit behind, so I’d appreciate the latest update.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’ll check the list and see what tools we’re still missing, then I’ll report back with the latest update.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. Just keep reminding folks about Saturday and bring whatever tools you can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the Saturday repair drive plan and I’ll bring whatever tools I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — that means a lot. Keeping it simple and steady for Saturday really helps me right now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m ready — what’s the biggest fix you want me to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let me check which repairs are most urgent and who’s free, then I’ll report back. That should help us keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll keep the tools ready and wait for your update so we can tackle the biggest fix first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — 4:30 still works for me. Send the list when it’s ready, and I’ll handle what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll send the list as soon as I’ve got it together, and thanks for handling your part. We’re in good shape for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll be ready at 4:30 and watch for your list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Tess — I’m ready to keep it orderly. Just send me the latest time and I’ll help keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great — it’s still on and picking up nicely, so I’d head over soon if you can. If you see any extra screwdrivers, snag one for me too!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do — I’ll head over soon and keep an eye out for extra screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mina — the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday at the front porch. I’m keeping everything organized, so let me know if you need the updated details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. Do you still want me to bring tape and gloves?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes please, Mina — tape and gloves would be great. Thanks for checking in!
